Part.name: ATGM guidance sight
Part.description: Modern dual-aperture launcher optics, 14 kg. Assign this sight to one dedicated ATGM launcher using the normal sight selector. Scope view pitches up and down independently from the launch tube. For a powered two-axis assembly choose ATGM sight mount (azimuth + elevation) in ATGM mounts; requires Oscillating Turret. Place the launcher on the LOWER yaw platform and the sight on the UPPER pitch stage. Assign crew to the launcher and both motors, and provide a loader or ATGM automatic reserve. The native crew, motor torque, limits, ammunition and reloading remain. A motor shared with another cannon is never commandeered. Configure missile direction keys through Settings/keybinds using the Guide ATGM actions. Generic modern housing; no additional thermal or ranging capability.
